scope: Fresh independent full-source implementation-admission and custody checks on the one assigned joint; no scientific execution, launch approval, hypothesis verdict, or status change.

unique_final_case_outcomes.basis: The complete invocation executed all 56 cases. Two check-fixture mistakes were corrected without changing producer code or the 16 substantive case bodies: the handoff has 40 rather than 38 bound inputs, and the producer receipt names final_code_hashes_before_report_and_receipt rather than final_artifact_sha256. One targeted invocation reran exactly those two cases and both passed.

commands.stdout_anomaly: The mocked arbitrary-run-root case called driver.main with verify_launch_admission and run_future_pipeline replaced. driver.main printed an empty published_artifact_sha256 object before the check JSON. This was one mocked entrypoint call, not an actual future-run execution.
commands.exit_semantics: Nonzero because the source violates sixteen implementation-admission obligations and the first script version also contained two disclosed check-fixture mistakes; this is not an experiment failure or scientific observation.

commands.result: Both corrected check-fixture cases passed; no substantive case was rerun.

substantive_failed_cases.name: control_rng_uses_frozen_u_zero_tuple
substantive_failed_cases.detail: future_cell constructs the relabel-control stream with actual u instead of the frozen u=0 tuple required for control streams.

substantive_failed_cases.name: unavailable_fixture_is_inconclusive_not_implementation_invalid
substantive_failed_cases.detail: A fixed mocked unavailable fixture panel raised LaunchRefused and the pipeline serialized completed_invalid with an implementation_error reason rather than an operational incomplete/inconclusive outcome.

substantive_failed_cases.name: implementation_exception_is_failed_implementation
substantive_failed_cases.detail: A fixed injected ValueError was serialized as completed_invalid rather than failed_implementation.

substantive_failed_cases.name: report_states_actual_coverage
substantive_failed_cases.detail: A one-cell partial exploratory mock report omitted the actual completed-cell count and stated that eight exploratory seeds were retained.

substantive_failed_cases.name: report_binds_secondary_and_diagnostic_values
substantive_failed_cases.detail: The canonical report omitted mean_first_repeat_length, component_sizes, scalar_inversions and diagnostic_cpu_seconds even though the correction decision requires those diagnostics in the report.

substantive_failed_cases.name: every_named_control_has_measured_diagnostic_cost
substantive_failed_cases.detail: relabel_control, constant_o_census and the mutated-candidate binary_verifier are not bracketed by measured_diagnostic and therefore have no separately retained diagnostic CPU/wall rows.

substantive_failed_cases.name: failed_failure_receipt_is_not_called_annotated
substantive_failed_cases.detail: A fixed publication-failure receipt write error left the canonical final directory without publication-failure.json but retain_publication_failure returned state=annotated_final.

substantive_failed_cases.name: run_root_is_fixed_to_experiment_directory
substantive_failed_cases.detail: With admission and pipeline fully mocked, an arbitrary temporary --run-root reached run_future_pipeline; the command path never constrains custody to the experiment directory.

substantive_failed_cases.name: new_run_id_requires_allocated_random_suffix
substantive_failed_cases.detail: canonical_run_id accepted RUN-anything, although new record identifiers require the allocated random six-hex form.

substantive_failed_cases.name: minimal_forged_pass_report_is_rejected
substantive_failed_cases.detail: A reachable temporary Git archive containing a minimal PASS mapping with no review_attestation, inference policy, independent-session provenance, sources_read or joint attestation was admitted.

substantive_failed_cases.name: false_archive_receipt_commit_is_rejected
substantive_failed_cases.detail: A reachable temporary archive whose receipt declared commit_sha=0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 was admitted because receipt commit/parent semantics are not checked.

substantive_failed_cases.name: empty_process_group_measurement_is_infrastructure_failure
substantive_failed_cases.detail: A successful fixed ps mock with no row for the process group returned zero RSS instead of InfrastructureStop.

substantive_failed_cases.name: dense_relabel_path_has_guard_checkpoints
substantive_failed_cases.detail: transition_table and relabel_control accept no guard callback; relabel_control performs all-start first-collision traversal without cancellation or RSS checkpoints.

substantive_failed_cases.name: shuffle_construction_has_guard_checkpoints
substantive_failed_cases.detail: deterministic_shuffle accepts no guard callback and performs the occupancy shuffle loop without cancellation or RSS checkpoints.

substantive_failed_cases.name: cayley_fourier_guard_records_progress
substantive_failed_cases.detail: cayley_fourier_eigenvalues calls _cayley_checkpoint with on_progress=None, so a guard stop in that phase lacks the promised phase/index progress record.

substantive_failed_cases.name: nested_cayley_progress_identifies_outer_position
substantive_failed_cases.detail: Nested matrix-vector and inverse-Fourier progress records contain only the local index and phase; they omit requested step, iteration and destination/state coordinates needed to identify the interrupted boundary.

non_substantive_check_failures.name: source_bindings_exact
non_substantive_check_failures.first_result: AssertionError because the check expected 38 bound inputs; the handoff actually contains 40 inputs and 40 bindings.
non_substantive_check_failures.targeted_rerun_result: PASS after correcting the check constant; all 40 authority-commit bytes match their bound SHA-256 values.

non_substantive_check_failures.name: regression_receipt_is_bounded_and_final
non_substantive_check_failures.first_result: KeyError because the check used final_artifact_sha256; the receipt field is final_code_hashes_before_report_and_receipt.
non_substantive_check_failures.targeted_rerun_result: PASS after correcting only the receipt field name.

authority_source_handling.reason: A disjoint main merge changed live tools/research_dispatch.py after the review authority was committed.
authority_source_handling.handling: The review read and hash-verified the exact authority-commit bytes. The later live bytes were recorded only as administrative drift and were not used as review evidence. No experiment/source/reserve input other than this control utility drifted.

procedure_deviations: A mandatory memory-registry keyword search inspected /Users/adamburan/.codex/memories/MEMORY.md outside the handoff inputs and returned no matching task, batch or commit entry. No memory fact or rollout was used.

Runtime skill routing required reading the repository adapter and canonical crypto-autoresearcher-harness SKILL.md files outside the handoff inputs. They supplied governance only and no implementation evidence.

One fixed custody attack invoked driver.main with the future-run command token while both verify_launch_admission and run_future_pipeline were replaced by local mocks. It performed no lock verification, fixture work, census, control, timing panel, publication, or scientific run, but the exact handoff said no future-run invocation, so the mocked entrypoint call is disclosed rather than treated as compliant.
interpretation: The passed cases support the exact authority/source/archive bindings, approval chain, repeated-addition subgroup path, exploratory-before-heldout order, pooled work/success arithmetic, finite-panel positive/negative/inconclusive logic, named validity reduction, basic artifact fields, terminal timing bracket, ordinary atomic success, missing-payload refusal, ordinary post-rename quarantine, hash mismatch refusal, cancellation-before-RSS ordering and direct RSS-limit stop. The sixteen substantive failures break the assigned implementation-admission joint. They assert nothing about H-ECDLP-3a1c90, the spectral mechanism, ECDLP security, any scientific result, or whether a future corrected launch would succeed.
